1.title: Laurel Canyon Wants Its Beloved Hippie Store Frozen in Time
1.summary: The country store that was a hub for rock musicians like Jim Morrison and Graham Nash faces challenges and change. Supporters are trying to make it a landmark.

2.title: Will Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez Run for President in 2028? Here’s What She Said.
2.summary: In a wide-ranging interview, the New York congresswoman offered her most detailed insight yet into how she is thinking about a possible presidential run.

3.title: Paramount settles lawsuit with US states, clearing way for $110bn merger with Warner Bros
3.summary: The deal includes an agreement to produce 30 films a year, or Paramount will be forced to sell off parts of its company.

4.title: The Other Victims of China’s Church Crackdown
4.summary: Cherie Geng is trying to free her husband, a pastor, who was among dozens of church members detained by the Chinese police. At the same time, she must rebuild her life in exile.

5.title: Lithuania ready to 'fight back' but has evacuation plans in face of Russia threats, PM tells BBC
5.summary: Sinkevičius told BBC Newsnight Lithuanians feel "constantly threatened" by Moscow, but the nation was prepared to "fight back" if attacked.

6.title: Eleven injured in shooting outside Turkish school
6.summary: Footage appears to show a male in the area carrying a firearm, while officials say the attacker has been captured.
